findings.claim: The touch points say page.test.tsx gains the `continue` view, but its ROUTES table was not extended, so no route-level test checks that ?view=continue reaches FolderBrowser with no folder path and view 'continue'.
findings.impact: Coverage gap only. If page.tsx later started branching on `continue`, or stopped passing it through, the route test would not notice the new view. The behaviour itself is not shown to be wrong.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/app/drive/[name]/__tests__/page.test.tsx:62-72 lists favorites, liked, recent, recent-added, all, trash, missing, home and inbox, with no continue; :95 is toHaveLength(9). page.test.tsx is not in r1/classification.json zones_touched, while layout.test.tsx:200 does add ["continue"].
findings.repro: Read page.test.tsx:62-96: no ROUTES entry has view 'continue'.

bucket_proposal.reason: A test-coverage gap against a touch point. It is not a behaviour defect within the threat model.
